headline: Edible Garden expands Walmart distribution for fresh herbs across the Mid-Atlantic
summary: Edible Garden AG Incorporated (NASDAQ:EDBL) is broadening its partnership with Walmart by expanding distribution of its fresh cut herbs to additional stores throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. The company said the enlarged distribution program is scheduled to begin shipping products during the third quarter of 2026, increasing the availability of its fresh herb range to consumers across the region.
